notes.title: Devlog 01 - Expeditions and transportation system
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/325e095dcaaa1bc03377a21d8beb41a736ec96e8.png"]We’re excited to announce the start of a devlog series for Dragonscale Monastery! 
We’ll be sharing a behind-the-scenes look at our work on this exciting game. From the creative process and the challenges we face, to everything that goes into bringing the project to life — each episode will be packed with details about the game’s mechanics and artistic vision.

We want you to be part of this journey, so stay with us and follow every step of Dragonscale Monastery’s development! 🔥🐉


[previewyoutube="bLIcfQc1WeA;full"][/previewyoutube]
